papers.title: Concentration inequalities via zero bias couplings
findings: Section3.1 Eq10 explicitly gives doubly centered array variance for uniform random permutation. Polarization and rank-one arrays directly yield the present covariance/tensor-margin identities.
Theorem3.1 cites a known zero-bias coupling for n>=3; no new concentration theorem is established here.
limits: Selected pp1,4,5 only. Theorem2.1 full proof and later conjugacy-class results not read or independently audited.
Exact arXiv watermark v3 is1Jan2014; the title-page internal dateJune4,2018 is a separate observed field.
Original1951 Hoeffding full text not acquired; this is a later original coupling/concentration paper explicitly giving the known variance.

papers.title: Attention is not not Explanation
findings: Section2.1 argues attention distributions are jointly learned with the rest of the model and standalone manipulations do not automatically certify model-consistent alternatives.
Introduction describes uniform baseline, multi-seed variance calibration, frozen diagnostic and end-to-end adversarial alternatives as distinct tests.
limits: Only pp1-3 read, no detailed later protocols/results, Section5 theoretical discussion or code reproduced.
Neither paper proves that local fixed-head intervention is worthless; it has a narrower scope than model necessity or human explanation.
